description:
Use this when the user needs the list of Indian market indices DalalOS covers.

Returns every index whose membership DalalOS holds, with the number of members. These names are the `index` values for list_index_constituents, get_market_heatmap, get_top_movers and screen_stocks. For indices with P/E and P/B history use list_index_valuations.
name: list_indices
title: Available indices
